'''Bina Lew''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who frequented the [[Sunken Sarlacc cantina]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She and her friend [[Alison Dawn]] were frequently hit on by [[Harez Bant]].
